To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the efficiency of programs can be expressed by symbolic formulas; (2) the numeric values of the symbolic variables can be obtained by linear programming; (3) the symbolic formulas can be generated automatically by a Prolog program; and (4) the symbolic formulas manipulation package (Maples) can be used to obtain the numeric values of variables.
we developed tools that enable the user to estimate the execution efficiency of Pascal and C-like programs.

the use of symbolic formulas to express efficiency and of a linear programming solver to determine the numeric value of the variables in these formulas is a powerful tool for micro-analysis of programs.
